Our school has a team of filtered teachers who continuously strive to provide the best quality of education, not only through bookish knowledge but also focusing on the overall development of the students. Students are the asset of our institution. We encourage our students to develop their thirst for knowledge, and embark on new challenges. We believe it is necessary to work on all spheres that will eventually help in shaping an individual. We are confident that our school will continue to rise higher, and we are grateful for the constant support. Email: svaburdwan@gmail.com Phone: (+91) 8145 730 807 Pragya Gupta (Managing Director) We have a vision to empower the young minds so that they excel in various fields - academics as well as in co-curricular activities. The school has also introduced “ activity days” on Saturdays which is an initiative taken so that the students relax and indulge themselves in various other activities ( dance, water activity, math mania , art and craft, quiz , play corner , audio-visual classes and more). We believe such activities provide a break from the monotonous schedule and help the students to rejuvenate. The management and the entire family of St. Vincent’s Academy acknowledges the trust that the parents have shown and we shall not let this down. Thank you for your constant support. We are confident that our school will continue to rise higher, and we are grateful for the constant support.
